
		<h2>
			<a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/monkeyhua/p/19762115" title="发布于 2026-03-24 15:13">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">正则表达式基础篇</span>
    

</a>

		</h2>
		    <div id="cnblogs_post_description" style="display: none">
        
        正则表达式提供强大的查找和替换功能，绝大部分语言（C#、Python、Java等）及大多数工具（Notepad++、VsCode、Vs等）都提供内部支持。
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<h2 id="介绍">介绍</h2>
<blockquote>
<p>正则表达式提供强大的查找和替换功能，绝大部分语言（<a href="https://learn.microsoft.com/zh-cn/dotnet/standard/base-types/regular-expressions" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">C#</a>、<a href="https://docs.python.org/3/howto/regex.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">Python</a>、<a href="https://docs.oracle.com/en/java/javase/25/docs/api/java.base/java/util/regex/package-summary.html" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">Java</a>等）及大多数工具（<a href="https://npp-user-manual.org/docs/searching/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">Notepad++</a>、<a href="https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/editing/codebasics#_advanced-search-options" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">VsCode</a>、<a href="https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/visualstudio/ide/using-regular-expressions-in-visual-studio?view=visualstudio" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">Vs</a>等）都提供内部支持。</p>
</blockquote>
<h2 id="分类">分类</h2>
<ul>
<li><strong><a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/monkeyhua/p/19764425" target="_blank">单字符匹配</a></strong>（Single Match）：用来匹配单个字符；</li>
<li><strong><a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/monkeyhua/p/19767717" target="_blank">字符集匹配</a></strong>（Sets Match）：用来匹配多个字符；</li>
<li><strong><a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/monkeyhua/p/19767859" target="_blank">特殊字符匹配</a></strong>（Special Match）：此处代指转义字符；</li>
<li><strong><a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/monkeyhua/p/19767945" target="_blank">空白字符匹配</a></strong>（Whitespace Match）：包含换行符、制表符等；</li>
<li><strong><a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/monkeyhua/p/19768342" target="_blank">字符类型匹配</a></strong>（Type Match）：用来匹配字母、数字、空白字符等；</li>
<li><strong><a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/monkeyhua/p/19768577" target="_blank">重复匹配</a></strong>（Repeat Match）：用来匹配零次、一次、多次等；</li>
<li><strong><a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/monkeyhua/p/19769655" target="_blank">位置匹配</a></strong>（Position Match）：用来匹配字母、字符边界位置；</li>
<li><strong><a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/monkeyhua/p/19770292" target="_blank">子表达式匹配</a></strong><sup>高级</sup>（Subexpression Match）：用来提供分组匹配；</li>
<li><strong><a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/monkeyhua/p/19770576" target="_blank">反向引用匹配</a></strong><sup>高级</sup>（Backreference Match）：同时搭配子表达式匹配，可提供强大的替换功能；</li>
<li><strong><a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/monkeyhua/p/19771072" target="_blank">前后匹配</a></strong><sup>高级</sup>（Lookaround Match）：用来向前匹配和向后匹配；</li>
<li><strong><a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/monkeyhua/p/19774354" target="_blank">条件匹配</a></strong><sup>高级</sup>（Condition Match）：一般搭配反向引用匹配和前后匹配来使用。</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="元字符速览表">元字符速览表</h2>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>类别</th>
<th>元字符</th>
<th>备注</th>
<th>说明</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/monkeyhua/p/19764425" target="_blank">单字符</a></td>
<td>.</td>
<td></td>
<td>匹配单个任意字符</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/monkeyhua/p/19767717" target="_blank">字符集</a></td>
<td>[]</td>
<td></td>
<td>匹配<strong>多个字符</strong>中的一个</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>[-]</td>
<td></td>
<td>匹配<strong>字符范围</strong>中的一个</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>[^]</td>
<td></td>
<td>匹配除当前字符集<strong>以外的</strong>字符</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/monkeyhua/p/19767859" target="_blank">特殊</a></td>
<td>\</td>
<td></td>
<td>用于转义其他元字符</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/monkeyhua/p/19767945" target="_blank">空白</a></td>
<td>[\b]</td>
<td></td>
<td>退格键（Backspace）</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>\f</td>
<td></td>
<td>换页键（Form feed）</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>\n</td>
<td></td>
<td>换行（Line feed）</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>\r</td>
<td></td>
<td>回车（Carriage return）</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>\t</td>
<td></td>
<td>水平制表符（Tab）</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>\v</td>
<td></td>
<td>垂直制表符（Vertical tab）</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/monkeyhua/p/19768342" target="_blank">类型</a></td>
<td>\d</td>
<td>[0-9]</td>
<td>匹配任何<strong>数字</strong>字符</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>\D</td>
<td>[^0-9]</td>
<td>匹配任何<strong>非数字</strong>字符</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>\w</td>
<td>[a-zA-Z0-9_]</td>
<td>匹配任何<strong>字母、数字、下划线</strong></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>\W</td>
<td>[^a-zA-Z0-9_]</td>
<td>匹配字母、数字、下划线以外的字符</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>\s</td>
<td>[\f\n\r\t\v]</td>
<td>匹配任何<strong>空白</strong>字符</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>\S</td>
<td>[^\f\n\r\t\v]</td>
<td>匹配任何<strong>非空白</strong>字符</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>\x</td>
<td></td>
<td>匹配十六进制值对应的ASCII字符</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>\0</td>
<td></td>
<td>匹配八进制值对应的ASCII字符</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/monkeyhua/p/19768577" target="_blank">重复</a></td>
<td>+</td>
<td></td>
<td>匹配<strong>一次</strong>或多次字符</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>*</td>
<td></td>
<td>匹配<strong>零次</strong>或多次字符</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>？</td>
<td></td>
<td>匹配<strong>零次或一次</strong>字符</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td><em>{n}</em></td>
<td></td>
<td>确定次数匹配</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td><em>{n1,n2}</em></td>
<td></td>
<td>次数范围匹配</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td><em>{n,}</em></td>
<td></td>
<td>最小次数匹配</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>+?</td>
<td></td>
<td>匹配<strong>一个</strong>或多个字符<strong>（懒惰）</strong></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>*?</td>
<td></td>
<td>匹配<strong>零个</strong>或多个字符<strong>（懒惰）</strong></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>{n,}?</td>
<td></td>
<td>次数范围匹配<strong>（懒惰）</strong></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/monkeyhua/p/19769655" target="_blank">位置</a></td>
<td>\b</td>
<td></td>
<td>匹配<strong>单词开始或者结束</strong>位置</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>^</td>
<td></td>
<td>匹配<strong>字符串开始</strong>位置</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>$</td>
<td></td>
<td>匹配<strong>字符串结束</strong>位置</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>(?m)</td>
<td><strong>部分支持</strong></td>
<td>置于开始处，代表支持<strong>匹配多行</strong></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/monkeyhua/p/19770292" target="_blank">子表达式</a></td>
<td>()</td>
<td></td>
<td>用于<strong>成组匹配</strong></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/monkeyhua/p/19770576" target="_blank">反向引用</a></td>
<td>\n $n</td>
<td><strong>平台间格式有差异</strong></td>
<td>用于引用<strong>第n项</strong>子表达式，索引<strong>从1开始</strong></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>\E</td>
<td>替换时用</td>
<td>作为<code>\L</code>或者<code>\U</code>的<strong>终止符</strong></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>\l</td>
<td>替换时用</td>
<td>下一个字符转换成<strong>小写</strong></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>\L</td>
<td>替换时用</td>
<td>下一个字符至<code>\E</code>转换成<strong>小写</strong></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>\u</td>
<td>替换时用</td>
<td>下一个字符转换成<strong>大写</strong></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>\U</td>
<td>替换时用</td>
<td>下一个字符至<code>\E</code>转换成<strong>大写</strong></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/monkeyhua/p/19771072" target="_blank">前后</a></td>
<td>(?=)</td>
<td><strong>不包括匹配字符</strong></td>
<td>根据匹配字符<strong>向前</strong>查找内容</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>(?&lt;=)</td>
<td><strong>部分支持</strong></td>
<td>根据匹配字符<strong>向后</strong>查找内容</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>(?!)</td>
<td></td>
<td>根据<strong>非匹配</strong>字符<strong>向前</strong>查找内容</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>(?&lt;!)</td>
<td><strong>部分支持</strong></td>
<td>根据<strong>非匹配</strong>字符<strong>向后</strong>查找内容</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/monkeyhua/p/19774354" target="_blank">条件</a></td>
<td>(?(backref)true)</td>
<td></td>
<td><strong>反向引用</strong>条件匹配</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td></td>
<td>(?(look)true)</td>
<td></td>
<td><strong>前后</strong>条件匹配</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
